query:
SELECT empresaSlug, data, cat9 FROM faturamentos WHERE data IN ('2026-03-01','2026-03-02','2026-03-28') AND empresaSlug IN ('MASCOTE','MORUMBI') ORDER BY empresaSlug, data;

SELECT empresaSlug, SUM(CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL)) as total_cat9 FROM faturamentos WHERE data LIKE '2026-03-%' AND empresaSlug IN ('MASCOTE','MORUMBI') GROUP BY empresaSlug;
